name: linux-dns-flush
title: Flush the DNS cache
description: Clears the systemd-resolved cache (resolvectl flush-caches). Machines without systemd-resolved keep no local cache, so there is nothing to flush.
measure: if command -v resolvectl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-active --quiet systemd-resolved 2>/dev/null; then
arh_blocker "No local DNS cache service runs here"
